# Trigger-log hash scopes

Every row of the trigger log carries `content_sha256`, the SHA-256 of a canonical JSON
object built from the row. `standpipe verify` recomputes it. The **hash scope** is the closed
list of fields that object contains: a field outside the scope can change without
`verify` noticing, so each list below is exhaustive. A field not named here is not
covered by the hash.

Dotted names (`caller.token_id`) are members of a nested object in the canonical form.
Every key is always present; an unset value is hashed as `null`, so the key set never
depends on the row's values.

## Redactable fields

`standpipe forget` sets these fields to NULL on `trigger` and `trigger_rejected` rows
older than a cut-off. They are outside every hash scope, so a redacted row still verifies:

`caller.source_ip`, `caller.user_agent`, `reason_text`

## `trigger`

**In scope:** `schema_version`, `event_type`, `event_id`, `ts`, `origin_forge`, `epoch`, `caller.token_id`, `caller.name`, `target.project`, `target.workflow`, `target.ref`, `inputs_hash`, `inputs_validation`, `correlation`, `idempotency_key`, `idempotency_outcome`, `require_raw`, `decision.backend`, `decision.reason`, `outcome`, `request_id`.

**Outside the scope:**

| Field | Why |
|---|---|
| `content_sha256` | the hash itself; a self-referential hash cannot be recomputed |
| `caller.source_ip` | redactable: `standpipe forget` sets it to NULL, so it must stay outside the hash |
| `caller.user_agent` | redactable: `standpipe forget` sets it to NULL, so it must stay outside the hash |
| `reason_text` | redactable: `standpipe forget` sets it to NULL, so it must stay outside the hash |

`outcome` is hashed as a constant `null`: a trigger row is written with no outcome and never updated, because the outcome is carried by its own `trigger_outcome` event.

## `run_link`

**In scope:** `schema_version`, `event_type`, `event_id`, `ts`, `trigger_event_id`, `run_id`, `resolution`, `resolution_source`, `origin_forge`, `epoch`.

**Outside the scope:**

| Field | Why |
|---|---|
| `content_sha256` | the hash itself; a self-referential hash cannot be recomputed |
| `superseded_by` | the one column a run_link row is ever updated in (when a stronger resolution supersedes it); hashing it would make every superseded link fail verification without any tampering |

This event type has no redactable field.

## `trigger_outcome`

**In scope:** `schema_version`, `event_type`, `event_id`, `ts`, `origin_forge`, `epoch`, `trigger_event_id`, `outcome_status`, `outcome_reason`, `outcome_http_status`, `outcome_upstream_duration_ms`.

**Outside the scope:**

| Field | Why |
|---|---|
| `content_sha256` | the hash itself; a self-referential hash cannot be recomputed |

No redactable field; the row is final when written. `origin_forge` and `epoch` are hashed from the row's own values rather than assumed constant, so changing either in an archive is detected.

## `trigger_rejected`

**In scope:** `schema_version`, `event_type`, `event_id`, `ts`, `origin_forge`, `epoch`, `caller.token_id`, `caller.name`, `target.project`, `target.workflow`, `target.ref`, `reject_reason`, `outcome_http_status`, `suppressed_count`, `suppressed_since`, `request_id`.

**Outside the scope:**

| Field | Why |
|---|---|
| `content_sha256` | the hash itself; a self-referential hash cannot be recomputed |
| `caller.source_ip` | redactable: `standpipe forget` sets it to NULL, so it must stay outside the hash |
| `caller.user_agent` | redactable: `standpipe forget` sets it to NULL, so it must stay outside the hash |
| `reason_text` | redactable: `standpipe forget` sets it to NULL, so it must stay outside the hash |

`suppressed_*` are inside the scope because the row is final when written: the counter accumulates in memory and the row is written once, when the coalescing window closes.

## `run_observed`

**In scope:** `schema_version`, `event_type`, `event_id`, `ts`, `trigger_event_id`, `run_id`, `conclusion`, `origin_forge`, `epoch`.

**Outside the scope:**

| Field | Why |
|---|---|
| `content_sha256` | the hash itself; a self-referential hash cannot be recomputed |

No redactable field and nothing is ever updated, so the scope is every field of the event except `content_sha256`. There is no `status` field: only GitHub's `conclusion` is recorded.
